item.title: Request for light shield on street lighting pole, light is too bright., 3rd August
item.description:
Dear Highways Team, I am writing to formally request the installation of a rear/side light shield or cowl on the street light located details above. my property is at 102.The street light (Pole Reference: [column N10, description MANOR 115/117 ) is causing significant intrusive light pollution into my home. Excessive glare is spilling directly from both the front and sides of the lantern straight into my bedroom window. This intense, unfiltered light completely disrupts my sleep and makes it very difficult to rest at night.While I understand the necessity of maintaining public highway illumination, the current lateral and backward light spill is excessive and constitutes a light nuisance. A physical shield or deflector would successfully block the glare from entering my property while keeping the pavement and road below safely lit.Could you please confirm if a technician can inspect this lamp and fit a suitable shroud or shield to resolve this issue? Thank you for your assistance, and I look forward to your response. Kind regards, Zara Robinson-Marshall

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Dallinger Road, Hither Green, Greater London
